disclaimer: BONSAI v1 is not a hostile-native-code sandbox. Process isolation, bounded messages, OS resource controls, least-privilege launch, and fail-closed termination protect the instrument from faulty adapters. Hostile arbitrary-native-code evaluation remains parked (P-05).

boundaries.name: faulty-or-malformed-agents
boundaries.trust_boundary: adapter process protocol and supervisor launch
boundaries.residual_risk: Native code can use ambient OS APIs outside BONSAI-controlled handles. This is not a sandbox.

boundaries.name: event-floods
boundaries.residual_risk: A privileged collector or host process outside ingest can still consume host resources.

boundaries.name: artifact-bombs
boundaries.trust_boundary: agent storage broker and blob intake
boundaries.residual_risk: Caps apply to BONSAI-brokered paths. Unbrokered ambient writes are outside the claim.

boundaries.name: path-and-symlink-attacks
boundaries.trust_boundary: filesystem grants under the run root
boundaries.residual_risk: A process with ambient filesystem APIs can still leave the declared tree. D-21 applies.

boundaries.name: bundle-tampering
boundaries.trust_boundary: result-bundle hashes and optional HMAC signatures
boundaries.residual_risk: HMAC uses an operator-supplied local key. There is no external key service.

boundaries.name: observer-to-agent-leakage
boundaries.trust_boundary: launch policy, environment, and protocol payloads
boundaries.residual_risk: Isolation is an interface contract, not an adversarial OS sandbox.

boundaries.name: secrets
boundaries.trust_boundary: inventory sanitizer, verification redaction, and publication review
boundaries.residual_risk: Redaction is defense in depth. Operators must not pass secrets on command lines.

boundaries.name: local-dashboard
boundaries.trust_boundary: read-only local viewer and report renderer
threats: writing observer state from a dashboard
controls: no listener or SaaS dashboard in v1
boundaries.residual_risk: A local HTML file can still be opened by a browser with the operator's privileges. P-08 parks multi-user services.

boundaries.name: dependency-and-build-risks
boundaries.residual_risk: A clean physical machine restore is separately attested. CI offline tests are not that attestation.

boundaries.name: privileged-collectors
boundaries.residual_risk: When a collector is authorized and privileged, host integrity risk increases. E3/lab probes stay parked (P-01).
